full_judgment: "In a fiscal or taxing statute one has to look merely at what is clearly said therein, for there is no room for any intendment nor for any equity or for any presumption. In case of unresolved ambiguity, it may be interpreted favorably to the citizen but nothing more. The attempt of the Court in case of ambiguity is to be guided by the principle of justice and fairness and to try to arrive at a true meaning of word."
